basic_info.description: 3564 17th Street presents the rare opportunity to purchase a classic 1920's era 6 unit apartment building in the Mission Dolores neighborhood, one of San Francisco's premiere rental locations. The property consists of 6 large one bedroom apartment units and 2 small one car garages. These large units boast hardwood floors, walk-in closets, built-in cabinets, and loads of natural light. This property enjoys a huge, fantastic backyard with abundant possibilities. The building has been well maintained by the same owners for generations. The units are separately metered for gas and electricity. Each unit has its own water heater. Tenants pay for their own heat and hot water. The seismic work has been completed. Significant Rental Upside!
